damret_cudda: The town and harbour also called Queda in the text.
damret_way: Pulo Way, the island used as a landmark off Sumatra.
damret_jonca: The second part of the river and settlement name Passange Jonca.
damret_oliver: The seaman who represented himself as a captain.
damret_trangambar: The Danish settlement on the Coromandel coast.
damret_johanna: The island called Johanna in the voyage account.
damret_jeoly: The islander brought to England by Dampier.
damret_meangis: The home island reported by Jeoly.
damret_augustin: The bay named Augustin on Madagascar.
damret_driscall: The Irish interpreter who lived at Achin.
damret_bowrey: The captain named Bowrey or Bowry in the source.
damret_curtana: The vessel commanded by Captain Welden.
damret_morgan: The seafarer who reported the crew’s subsequent history.
damret_barlow: Mate of the Rainbow, entrusted with Dampier’s packet.
damret_knight: Captain of the brigantine that sailed with the Cygnet.
damret_humes: A witness from the Ann of London.
damret_freke: Captain of the Ann of London.
damret_indrapore: An English trading station on Sumatra.
damret_fanam: A local monetary unit in Dampier’s brokerage account.
damret_pagoda: The coin used to quote the seamen’s monthly pay.
damret_mess: The small gold coin that Captain Bowrey gave the sailors.
damret_metcalf: The captain who offered Dampier a berth as mate.
damret_michael: Jeoly’s enslaver on Mindanao and an interpreter for Raja Laut.
damret_drammer: The English term as given for the resin used in Jeoly’s tattoos.
damret_hadda: Word in Jeoly’s quoted utterance about Meangis.
damret_se: Word preceding Bullawan in Jeoly’s reported utterance.
damret_bobby: Term glossed by Dampier as hogs, cited as an insult.
damret_babbi: The form Dampier glosses as woman or female.
damret_mamma: The form Dampier glosses as man or male.
damret_eyam: The form Dampier glosses as fowl.
damret_ponticheri: The French trading settlement on the Coromandel coast.
damret_pallacat: The Dutch settlement north of Fort St. George.
damret_duquesne: The French author whose account of the encounter Dampier disputes.
damret_groin: The Spanish anchorage at which Dampier recalled the hot wind.
damret_azimuth: The bearing compass used to observe variation at the Cape.
damret_tamarind: The fruit that Captain Heath shared with the messes.
damret_mangovolucres: Dampier’s name for a smaller sea bird used as a land sign.
damret_stiver: The coin in which Dampier quotes prices at the Cape.
damret_mum: The strong beer named separately in the Cape tavern account.
damret_albatross: Dampier’s name for the long-winged albatross seen offshore.
damret_laurence: St. Laurence, the alternative island name for Madagascar in the council’s discussion.
damret_comorin: Cape Comorin, the southern Indian headland.
damret_coppinger: A member of the crew whose course Dampier records.
damret_knox: The commander mentioned in the crew’s later history.
damret_cunnimere: The settlement on the Coromandel coast.
damret_agra: The city to which the seamen travelled.
damret_gentou: Dampier’s designation Gentou in the Peun passage.
damret_newyork: The port and place of origin of the ships trading in Madagascar.
damret_heath: Captain Heath, commander of the Defence.
damret_saintgeorge: The European trading post named Fort St. George on the Coromandel coast.

damret_oromkay: A local dignitary, called Oromkay or Oramkai, who receives the voyagers.
damret_shabander: The official overseeing the port and its foreign trade.
damret_peun: A hired guide or attendant whose duties include carrying, interpreting and running errands.
damret_wherry: A light river boat propelled by oars; the comparison is to a London wherry.
damret_halo: A ring of light around the sun or moon.
damret_factory: A mercantile station and its establishment overseas.
damret_gunner: The ship or fort officer responsible for the ordnance.
damret_pocketbook: A small notebook in which the writer copied courses and distances.
damret_intermarry: Descent from more than one community, in the narrator’s characterization of the Portuguese companion.
damret_meridian: The local meridian used for the sun's noon passage.
damret_rattan: A flexible climbing cane used to lash the canoe.
